method: Deterministic up to3000 samples among changed outer-skin vertices. At corresponding before/after positions cast inward along the same baseline area-weighted vertex normal, independently against each actual STL solid. Accept first entry within0.10mm of the exterior point and opposing exit dot<-0.25 within8mm.
scope: Local surface-edit regression only; unchanged cap and whole other regions are certified by coordinate audit, not redundantly sampled here.
limitations: Discrete ray crossings do not certify global minimum thickness. Complex thin rims may yield ambiguous or changing exit branches; missing samples and paired reductions retained for interpretation.
